en: Although it is a grim reminder of the winter hardships to come, the supply caravan from {1} is a welcome sight. Their eyes are alight with the anticipation of inspecting the splendid products of your industrious {@2}. [B]Take careful stock of your own stores. What these merchants offer might very well be the difference between a prosperous future and a slow and meaningless death.
